question: Does LinkStatic's listed bandwidth for a whole C-class range (100 Mbps, or 50 Mbps in Dubai, the Philippines, Mexico and South Korea) apply to each of the range's 256 addresses or to the range as a whole, and is per-ip-shaping then the right limits kind?
why: unverified: behind a sign-up or a customer-service contact. No public page states it. The range pages list the figure on the region row beside the price; the order request is one range line with a quantity of 1 and one bandwidth value; the page description calls bandwidth customizable; and the per-address products list their bandwidth per unit sold (enterprise ISP: 30 Mbps beside per-IP prices; TikTok line: 50, 80 or 100 Mbps as a unit price). The answer is behind a customer-service contact or a delivered range, and a throughput test from several of the 256 addresses at once would settle it; that needs an account and a payment. If the figure is shared by the whole range, per-ip-shaping (a throughput limit attached to the caller) fits less well and a throughput-per-lease term may be needed; decide after the measurement.
